CREATE TABLE prevstats AS
SELECT t.seq_scan, t.seq_tup_read, t.idx_scan, t.idx_tup_fetch,
       (b.heap_blks_read + b.heap_blks_hit) AS heap_blks,
       (b.idx_blks_read + b.idx_blks_hit) AS idx_blks,
       pg_stat_get_snapshot_timestamp() as snap_ts
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_user_tables AS t,
       pg_catalog.pg_statio_user_tables AS b
 WHERE t.relname='tenk2' AND b.relname='tenk2'
shape: CREATE TABLE prevstats AS SELECT t.seq_scan, t.seq_tup_read, t.idx_scan, t.idx_tup_fetch, (b.heap_blks_read + b.heap_blks_hit) AS heap_blks, (b.idx_blks_read + b.idx_blks_hit) AS idx_blks, pg_stat_get_snapshot_timestamp() AS snap_ts FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_user_tables AS t, pg_catalog.pg_statio_user_tables AS b WHERE (t.relname = 'tenk2') AND (b.relname = 'tenk2');

SELECT st.seq_scan >= pr.seq_scan + 1,
       st.seq_tup_read >= pr.seq_tup_read + cl.reltuples,
       st.idx_scan >= pr.idx_scan + 1,
       st.idx_tup_fetch >= pr.idx_tup_fetch + 1
  FROM pg_stat_user_tables AS st, pg_class AS cl, prevstats AS pr
 WHERE st.relname='tenk2' AND cl.relname='tenk2'

       st.idx_blks_read + st.idx_blks_hit >= pr.idx_blks + 1
  FROM pg_statio_user_tables AS st, pg_class AS cl, prevstats AS pr
 WHERE st.relname='tenk2' AND cl.relname='tenk2'
